verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no sandbox or test-mode environment for safely testing without touching production data. Easy self-hosting (gitea-docs-9, gitea-docs-23) would let a user stand up a separate instance, but that is a user-side workaround, not a product capability. Community mentions of a public 'Try Gitea'/test instance (gitea-comm-4, gitea-comm-13) describe a demo site, not a documented sandbox for testing against.
